purpose: Check that the static MathBridge web runtime can resolve its release assets and dynamic data manifests before merging to main.

runtime_logic_checks.method: The release-equivalent expanded browser runtime passed node --check before whitespace compaction; the committed blob was fetched again after update and follows the same checked program structure.

runtime_logic_checks.rule: The selected China grade is labelled as national-curriculum context, not as proof that every searched concept belongs to or begins in that grade.
Selected-grade PEP placements are preferred. If none exists, other relevant PEP placements are explicitly labelled as relevant placements rather than selected-grade placements.
Chinese UI does not render English-only diagnostic follow-up arrays; Chinese follow-ups are shown only when stored Chinese fields exist.
Designed revised-series placement remains separate from locality/term actual use.
Missing California/Texas overlays do not silently become Common Core state requirements.
Interface copy is direct, instructional and non-promotional.

packaging_repairs_completed: Restored four missing classroom-task base files referenced by the runtime manifest.
Restored five missing Chinese comparison files and three missing English comparison files referenced by the bilingual manifest.
Normalised invalid teaching-move references in restored task files.
Refreshed stale English perimeter/area PEP placement wording after revised-series verification.
